author: Kairos I
title: Experiment Template Smoke Test (Ridge Solve)
abstract: Imports lineage utilities and a template, performs a small ridge solve, times it, writes metrics to lineage/shared storage, and prints a concise summary.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/kairos')

from utils.text import to_snake, short_hash
from utils.timer import now
import experiment_template as et

def main():
    # Use slightly smaller n to be conservative on runtime
    metrics = et.run(seed=123, n=250, lam=1e-3)
    lp, sp, rid, metrics = et.save_metrics({"ts": now(), **metrics}, tag="template")
    print("TEMPLATE_OK")
    print("lineage_file:", lp)
    print("shared_file:", sp)
    print("run_id:", rid)
    print("resid:", metrics["resid"])
    print("elapsed:", metrics["elapsed"])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
